shadows.name: resting-plate

shadows.name: state-halo
shadows.purpose: Ring around the 7px status dot so it reads on white without becoming a badge.

shadows.name: editing-bar

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action in a panel; solid Work Blue, white label, 32px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--blue-fill, #1a63bd); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--blue-fill, #1a63bd); color: #fff; font: 500 12.5px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { flex: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #17589f; border-color: #17589f; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: #17589f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1a63bd); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-sunk, #f7f8fa); border-color: var(--rule, #e2e6ec); color: var(--ink-4, #636d7a); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button

narrative.overview:
This is a workbench, not a dashboard. It belongs to one person sitting at their own machine, mid-task, deciding whether their gateway and model catalogue will actually hold up. The surface is a light system-settings shell: white plates on a cool-grey ground, hairline boundaries, one restrained blue reserved for the action that commits. Nothing on the page is decoration; every element either states a fact, takes a value, or shows the result of a real call.

The second organising idea is that the catalogue stays put while you edit. Opening a model is not a modal and not a page change: the table narrows, a 344px inspector appears beside it, and the row you are editing stays visible under a blue tint with a 2px left bar. You never lose the thing in front of you while you change it. The same discipline governs truthfulness: a saved value and a runtime-adopted value are two labelled columns, and a verdict strip names the difference between them in words.

Deliberately absent: the previous instrument-panel/spectrum world (emission lines, sodium accent, calibration bands, zero-corner geometry) and the generic admin dashboard (hero metric tiles, gradient cards, coloured pills for every state). The user rejected the former, and this build replaces it rather than recolours it.
keyCharacteristics: Default light: white panels on a cool-grey ground, 1px rules, 6/8/12px radii, no heavy borders.
One blue action accent; green/amber/red appear only as a 7px dot plus a word, or as a tinted whole-block background.
The catalogue table is the centre of gravity; the inspector opens beside it, never over it.
Platform UI sans at 14px body with a 13px supporting tier, a 12.5px control tier and a 12px floor; tabular numerals and monospace for identifiers and measurements.
Saved and adopted are structurally separate facts, never one "current" cell.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue marks committing actions, the current view, focus, links, and the saved state. Headings and decorative marks stay neutral; a toolbar and its editor can each have a committing action.

rules.name: The Dot-and-Word Rule
rules.body: A state is a 7px dot plus a word ("运行中", "待重启", "未检查"). Tint is allowed only as a whole-block background (banner, note, diff, error list) or as a text colour on an error string — never as a row wash that leaves the word unread.

rules.name: The Two-Blues Rule
rules.body: Accent ink and accent fill are separate tokens. In dark mode ink lifts for legibility while the fill stays dark enough for white label text. Never paint white text on the accent ink.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text goes below 12px. 12px is the label, tag, hint and mono tier; a value that will not fit is renamed or wrapped, never shrunk.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the body, so context sizes, durations, counts and request times line up in columns. Monospace marks a string as an identifier; tabular numerals keep figures comparable.

rules.name: The One-Lift Rule
rules.body: A surface is either at rest (1px rule + shadow-1) or lifted (rule-strong + shadow-2) for as long as it is the thing being edited. Nothing carries a heavier shadow to look important.

rules.name: The Nested-Radius Rule
rules.body: Use the 12/8/6/4px scale for plates, groups, controls and micro marks. Fields can sit directly in a plate when spacing already establishes the group; an extra wrapper is not required.

dos: Do keep 已保存 and 实际采用 in separate labelled columns with a verdict strip between the facts; they are different states of the world.
Do let the edited row stay visible: inspector to the right, row tinted, 2px blue bar, table position unchanged.
Do state every capability, effort and limit as a declared catalogue value, and say out loud that declaring vision does not grant it.
Do use blue for committing actions in each action group, focus, links, the current view and the saved state.
Do carry state as dot + word, with a tinted block when the whole message is the state (restart pending, save failed).
Do keep the 32px control height and 12px text floor so dense tables and forms stay aligned and legible.
Do show a truthful intermediate state for every operation (opbar, busy button, disabled save, empty state).
donts: Don't merge saved and adopted into one "current model" row, or let a policy preview read as a runtime observation.
Don't invent models, prices, request counts or capabilities; screenshots used for acceptance are not evidence of what a model can do.
Don't put the model editor in a modal that hides the table, or navigate away from the list to edit a row.
Don't tint a whole table row green/amber/red to encode state; red is reserved for errors and the delete confirmation.
Don't use blue decoratively — headings, icons, borders and secondary buttons stay neutral.
Don't shrink functional text below 12px, or set prose in monospace.
Don't make dark the default or treat it as automatic unless the user picked 跟随系统; light is the shipped default.
Don't render credentials, the panel key or raw configuration in the DOM, and don't imply the panel can restart the gateway.
